narr: Moisture and instability pooled along a nearly stationary frontal boundary across southeast Virginia on August 18. Slow-moving showers and storms trained over the lower Virginia Peninsula region, with flash flooding occurring in the late afternoon and evenings hours.
ev: The 911 call center reported a vehicle stalled from driving into 1.5 to 2 feet of water on Old Williamsburg Road.
The public reported Winchester Drive flooded at Kraft Elementary School.
A VDOT camera showed water visibly rushing over the roadway at the intersection of Jefferson Avenue and Yorktown Road.
The 911 call center reported water covering the roadway on Pocahontas Trail.
Law enforcement reported flooding along Warwick Boulevard. Additionally, a water rescue was reported at an apartment building nearby on Chelsea Place.
A picture on social media showed high water reaching the tops of tires on parked cars.
